caption: The drawing depicts a wooden toy figure standing upright on a round black base. The figure is human-like and wears a red torso covering or armor, beige pants, and black boots. Its arms, which are jointed at the shoulders, are elongated and end in large, downward-curved gray blades rather than hands. The figure has a face with a mustache, dark eyebrows, and a slight grin. Atop its head is a black helmet with a rounded crest and a knob on top, matching the color of the boots and base. The figure's overall composition centers it on a plain beige or off-white background bordered by lightly sketched rectangles, which frame the entire subject.
title: Whirligig: Hessian Soldier
